title: Baseline water stress by country, WRI Aqueduct 4.0
description: Country-level baseline water stress score and category (country_baseline sheet, 'bws' indicator) with the country's ranking, for 2019-baseline conditions.

sources.title: WRI Aqueduct 4.0: water risk data (global maps, country and province rankings)
sources.version: Aqueduct 4.0 (Kuzma et al. 2023), files as served 2026-10-22
sources.licence_quote: This dataset is licensed in accordance with the terms of a creative commons license (CC BY 4.0).

attribution: Kuzma et al. (2023), Aqueduct 4.0: Updated decision-relevant global water risk indicators, WRI Technical Note, doi:10.46830/writn.23.00061 (CC BY 4.0).
method: Sheet country_baseline, rows with indicator_name 'bws' (baseline water stress), industrial-weighted ('weight' column kept) as published.
caveats: Country aggregates hide basin-level stress: a data-centre site's local water stress is not the national value (province_baseline and the gridded zip are in the raw folder).
